reason: At base REGEX_FORMAT matched Y{1,4} but format() only implements YY/YYYY, so lone Y and YYY fell through to the zone-offset fallback, not literal output as the test expects.
Head changes REGEX_FORMAT to YYYY|YY so lone Y/YYY are no longer matched and stay literal; the added display.test.js regression asserts exactly this.
The PR is a pure behavior-preserving refactor (extracts the %-check into tryDecodeURIComponent); decoding of %20 in path params already worked at base.
Refactored tryDecodeURIComponent does the same decode-if-%-present as before; percent-encoded path params are still decoded.
reschedule() at base never updates @score, so entry.score/at still return the stale pre-reschedule value and the test assertions fail.
Head adds @score = at.to_f after zincrby, so the in-memory entry reflects the new time immediately as the test requires.
PR only touches Range-header whitespace trimming; Content-Type charset parsing already handles text/plain; charset=UTF-8 and is unaffected.
Same unrelated Range-header change; Content-Type/charset parsing behaves as before and satisfies the test.
PR only changes ComposerRepository download-failure log messages; ZipArchive addFile preserves source mtimes, so archived timestamps match the release date at base.
Logging-only PR does not affect archiving; repeated archives preserve source mtimes with no 1980 defaults.
PR changes only CredentialCache prefix matching; sync/async STJ deserialization of nullable-parent objects is unrelated and works normally.
CredentialCache change does not touch System.Text.Json; DeserializeAsync equals Deserialize for this payload, so no JsonException.
PR fixes FETCH FIRST on WITH HOLD cursors only; INET <<= ANY (subquery) is standard CockroachDB parsing and returns true for the contained address.
Cursor fix does not affect INET operators; >>= ANY (array) parses and evaluates to true.
At base every NO_PROXY entry is prefixed with a wildcard, producing all://*::1 which the URL parsing cannot interpret, so client construction raises.
Head maps IPv6 entries to all://[::1], a valid mount, so client construction succeeds and other hosts still work.
At base the flags/compiled-pattern check resets flags and compares against the reconstructed set, so DOTALL raises a ValueError instead of matching.

Head restores non-IGNORECASE flags for both flags= and compiled patterns; a.c with DOTALL matches a
c and not ac.
At base a group in the middle of a chain leaves recursive result parents, so the result tree/its tuple serialization is broken rather than preserving all four children.
Head updates prev_task/prev_res after each group, fixing the recursion so as_tuple/from_tuple round-trips all four child results.
At base encountering -- switches to trailing-values mode before the positional terminator is honored, so the first positional captures the trailing tokens too.
Head checks the current positional value_terminator before entering trailing-values mode, so cmd1 stops at -- and cmd2 receives --check.
At base the late OSC11 handler calls nvim_set_option_value which, after startup, fires OptionSet; background change also fires ColorScheme, so both fire.
Head wraps the set in :noautocmd, suppressing the OptionSet event the test expects to fire; only ColorScheme fires.
PR only reorders @derive attribute reads for redacted fields; changeset cast + validate_required still marks an omitted field invalid.
Compile-time @derive change does not affect runtime changeset validation; omitted required field still yields a can-be-blank error.
